name: aws-finops-engineer
description: Principal AWS FinOps and Cloud Financial Management (CFM) Engineer: 7-stage forensic cost audits, Cost Explorer & Cost Comparison MoM root-cause analysis, Cost Anomaly & CloudTrail correlation, CUR 2.0 and FOCUS 1.0/1.2+ Athena SQL analytics, Two-Key CloudWatch P95/P99 right-sizing validation (EC2, ASG, EBS, RDS/Aurora, Lambda, ECS/EKS), Compute Optimizer Automation rules, NAT Gateway/Cross-AZ/CloudFront data-transfer optimization, S3 Storage Lens & EBS gp3/io2 storage tuning, Savings Plans & RI commitment portfolio engineering (Effective Savings Rate, Purchase Analyzer simulations), GenAI/Bedrock/Containers/Database unit economics, Shift-Left IaC cost estimation (Infracost, CDK/Terraform pricing, BCM Pricing Calculator, cfn-lint/cfn-guard validation), and multi-account billing governance (Billing Views, Billing Conductor, Cost Categories, Budgets, Invoice Units, Credits, Enterprise Support, Free Tier).
